description: Donated by the Fuerza Aérea Guatemalteca and installed as the interactive exhibit "AeroAventura"; inaugurated 23 Jul 2024. A flight simulator has been fitted inside the cabin so children can "fly" over the city; the airframe is complete and indoors/on the museum grounds within the Galería Mi País. No registration or serial published by the Municipalidad or the museum. Sub-variant (210-series suffix) not stated by any source; so variant is blank. military_civilian recorded as military on the strength of the air-force provenance; though a Cessna 210 in FAG service was a liaison/utility machine and the airframe may well have had a civil life before that.
museum_name: Museo de los Niños de Guatemala
